title: Brutal Rhubarb & Custard Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid By Just Juice
description: Brutal's Rhubarb & Custard e-liquid is a confectionary classic for a reason. Its sublime balance of sharp, sour rhubarb sweetness and smooth, creamy custard flavour is a recipe that has never been bettered. Recreating that magic to perfection in an e-liquid, this flavour will transport you back to the days of classic sweets. With every puff, you'll relive the nostalgic flavours of Rhubarb & Custard that will take you back to the carefree days of childhood. Indulge in the delightful taste of Brutal's Rhubarb & Custard e-liquid and experience the perfect balance of sour and sweet candy flavours. Brutal's range of nic salt e-liquids offers a perfect balance of flavour, vapour production, and throat hit with their 50VG/50PG blend. Designed for e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices, these e-liquids come in 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, making them an excellent choice for vapers who seek immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Nicotine Salt e-liquids have a unique alkaline formulation that delivers a higher concentration of nicotine compared to regular freebase e-liquids. They provide a smooth throat hit at higher nicotine concentrations and are absorbed faster into the bloodstream. As a result, these e-liquids are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking satisfying nicotine relief with a smooth throat hit. Brutal e-liquid is a delicious new collection of e-liquids from UK's e-juice masters Just Juice. They are available in long-lasting 100ml shortfills and intensely satisfying Nic Salts. The range features five classic sweetshop flavours that are sure to light up your taste buds in a glow of warm memories. Brutal e-liquid's nostalgic favourites include Rhubarb and Custard, Red & Black's raspberry and blackcurrant gummies, Mr Jack's liquorice and aniseed, Sour Strawberry Bubblegum, and Raspberry Sour chew bars. Each Brutal vape flavour will transport you back to the carefree days of childhood when a visit to the tuck shop was the highlight of the day.
